subject: re-st
title: (R)RE.ST. ------ POL.DY.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-31 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two) accompanying Braxton's diagnostic on transformation: 'the route to transformation — positive transformation — will be as progressional as the developments which have produced this cycle, having to do with the gradual acquisition of information and composite functionalism as a means to move towards reinstatement.' (R)RE-ST (the reality of restructuralism) is crossed with POL-DY (political dynamics): the question is what restructuralism produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with political-dynamics — the (R) prefix marking that real restructuralism is what produces real transformation. POL-DY sits at the upper-center. DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism) branches from the main line and carries RIT-DY (ritual dynamics); POST (postulation) branches from RIT-DY and carries IST-P. T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) also branches from the main line and carries EXTN (existentialism), which carries IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics); METH (methodology) branches from IF-ST-DY and carries EXT-FT (extended functionalism).
